title: Reasoning tokens should stream separately into a collapsed chat dropdown
body: Split hidden reasoning/thinking text out of streamed replies, preserve it separately, and show it in the native chat as a collapsed dropdown instead of speaking or mixing it into the visible answer.
interface: think-filter extracts reasoning, reply streaming emits thought/reasoning fields, and visible speech excludes them. The tests call: the filter from `createThinkFilter` in `node-bot/utils/think-filter.js` has `getThought()`, returning the thought text captured so far.
why: Streaming prompt/reply plumbing is a common cross-cutting failure surface.
